source: Super Grok pacing + Hermes grok-4.7 switch (Grok Bot)
summary: Super Grok use-it-up pacing on /ai/usage (cycle Thu 10:31 PT, used % from readings + token-calibrated estimate, daily target, Mon/Tue behind warning, last-36h backlog list, opt-in auto-queue OFF). Closing reading 85% seeded for the cycle ending Oct 8 10:31 PT (app said ~54%: flat 0.05%/call and missed calls). Calibration now 0.593 %/M Hermes xai tokens; the per-token quota weight is the same for grok-build, 4.6 and 4.7. Hermes default + code/coder moved to xai-oauth/grok-4.7 (grok-build-0.1 is first fallback) and kept past midnight. Routing lesson: grok-4.7 fixed the :3001 git push in 20 calls / 4.5 min; grok-build failed after 45 calls.

grokbuild_push_attempt.outcome: wrong repo (hermes-agent), blamed GitHub branch protection, committed/merged in hermes-agent, patched approval_detection.py to allow git push origin main; main's upstream never restored

grok47_push_fix.outcome: found that index.tt hides the Remote/Push card without an upstream (dropped by the Oct 4 .git rebuild); restored the upstream and patched Util/Git.pm, Admin/Git.pm, index.tt on main (Shanta's own session, uncommitted)

resolves.title: Git page push to GitHub missing on :3001
resolves.note: Root cause: main had no upstream after the Oct 4 16:13 PT .git rebuild, and root/admin/git/index.tt shows the Remote/Push card only when tracking.upstream is set. Shanta's grok-4.7 session restored it at 11:00 PT (upstream set, plus small patches on main, uncommitted).

proposals.title: Super Grok use-it-up pacing card + meter-stale prompt + ranked backlog for Hermes
proposals.target: lib/Comserv/Util/AI/SuperGrokPacing.pm (new), lib/Comserv/Model/AI2/UsageMonitor.pm, root/ai/usage_pacing_card.tt (new), root/ai/usage.tt, lib/Comserv/Controller/AI/Usage.pm (/ai/usage_pacing_toggle), ... (full list in rationale)
proposals.rationale: Files: lib/Comserv/Util/AI/SuperGrokPacing.pm (new), lib/Comserv/Model/AI2/UsageMonitor.pm, root/ai/usage_pacing_card.tt (new), root/ai/usage.tt, lib/Comserv/Controller/AI/Usage.pm (/ai/usage_pacing_toggle), lib/Comserv/Controller/AI.pm, lib/Comserv/Controller/AI/Eval.pm, root/ai/eval/list.tt, script/supergrok_pacing.pl (new), script/supergrok_autoqueue.pl (new, not in cron), t/ai_supergrok_pacing.t (new, 36 tests). Weekly cycle Thu 10:31 PT. Used % = latest manual reading + (Hermes xai-oauth tokens since then x fitted rate), daily target = left / days left, on pace = within 5 points. Warns Mon/Tue when more than 10 points behind. In the last 36 h, with more than 20% left, ranks open HelpDesk tickets, eval proposals and TodoRank todos with copyable Hermes grok-4.7 one-shot commands. Auto-queue is opt-in (data/supergrok_pacing.json, default OFF). /ai/usage and /ai/eval show a prompt when the meter is more than 24 h old.

proposals.title: Hermes log timestamps: read local lines in the workstation zone even when the app process runs TZ=UTC
proposals.rationale: Comserv.pm sets TZ=UTC, so inside the app the local and UTC readings of a log line were identical. Calls shifted by 7 h, and the live calibration (0.626) disagreed with the offline one (0.593). Now uses local TZ=America/Vancouver (or HERMES_LOG_TZ) during the parse, then restores it.

proposals.title: Seed Super Grok readings: 85% closing (cycle ending Oct 8 10:31 PT) + 0% new cycle
proposals.rationale: Shanta 10:44 PT: about 83% before this morning, a bit more before the reset. The old estimate (~54%) used a flat 0.05%/call, while cost follows tokens (~100-160K mostly-cached tokens per call). It also counted only the session table (1,172 calls vs 1,426 in agent.log). A token fit over 7 intervals is consistent (CV 0.09), so there is no sign of big non-Hermes clients.

proposals.title: Hermes default + code/coder -> xai-oauth/grok-4.7; grok-build-0.1 first fallback; kept past midnight
proposals.rationale: Shanta approved 10:53 and 11:01 PT. The live xai-oauth /v1/models (via the hermes proxy, no login) lists grok-4.7 and grok-4.6. The API list price for 4.6 and 4.7 is the same ($2/$0.50/$6), 2-3x grok-build. But on the Super Grok meter, per-token weight is equal: weighting 4.x at 2.5x breaks the reading fit (CV 0.44 vs 0.09). So the only cost is ~1.6x tokens per call, offset by finishing in far fewer calls. Because there is no penalty, the midnight revert cron was added and then removed at 11:05 PT, per Shanta's 11:01 rule. Fallbacks: grok-build-0.1, then the north-mini/nemotron free models, then Ollama gemma4/qwen2.5-coder. Never v4-pro.

proposals.title: Routing rule: runtime/git/debugging tasks -> grok-4.7, not grok-build (Hermes alias table)
proposals.rationale: Lesson from Oct 8: grok-build spent 45 calls / 4.27M tokens (~2.5% weekly) in the wrong repo and never asked a clarifying question. grok-4.7 found and fixed the upstream/Remote-card issue in 20 calls / 2.66M tokens. Neither the app nor Hermes has a task-type routing table; the alias table is the closest thing. Proposal: aliases git and reasoner -> xai-oauth/grok-4.7 (code/coder already done), and launch git TUIs from ~/PycharmProjects/comserv2 rather than ~/.hermes/hermes-agent. Not applied.

proposals.title: supergrok_daily_guard: use it up (WEEK_OFF_AT 90 -> 98) and token calibration instead of 0.05%/call
proposals.rationale: WEEK_OFF_AT=90 stops Super Grok at 90% used, which conflicts with using it up. PCT_PER_CALL=0.05 undercounted this week (54% estimated vs 85% actual). Use 0.593%/M tokens from agent.log, or read the /ai/usage_live supergrok_pacing.used_pct. Not applied.
